Add your health data.

A daily CSV, JSON, or unzipped Apple Health XML file. A full year is ideal, but a shorter period works too.

↑or drop one file here · up to 300 MB

Which file should I use?

Apple Health
Unzip your Health export and choose export.xml.

Fitbit, Garmin, or another source
Use a CSV or JSON daily summary with a date and at least one supported measurement. Full archives and workout-only FIT/TCX files aren't supported yet.

Supported measurements
Resting heart rate, HRV, sleep hours, steps, active minutes, and mood (1–5). Missing fields are fine.

File imports only in this version. Live wearable connections are not available yet.

YOUR MUSICAL LANGUAGE

Choose what you hear.

These mappings are creative choices. Higher values do not automatically mean better health.

Sleep fullness plateaus at this target. HRV is compared within one device/method, with capped changes. Missing signals use a neutral texture; they never become zero.
LOCAL FILE PREVIEW

Confirm your fields.

Only a date and one measurement are required. Keep optional fields unmapped if unavailable. Choose one consistent device/method per file. Mood: 1–5, steps: count, active minutes: minutes, resting HR: bpm, HRV: ms. Convert other scales before importing.
